overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated FACTVERSE performance data highlights a clear viewer preference for extreme space anomalies, hypothetical 'What If' planetary scenarios, and counterintuitive cosmic facts, which significantly outperform older psychological and standard animal trivia. Videos focusing on bizarre planetary mechanics (e.g., Diamond planets, Dark planets, and Burning Ice planets) achieve higher views-per-day and stronger likes-per-view ratios. Recent uploads from late September and early October show exceptional traction compared to older September content, proving that high-stakes, visually striking space concepts drive the strongest short-form retention and engagement.

winning_patterns.pattern: Extreme Planetary 'What If' & Bizarre Weather Scenarios
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) show strong sustained performance and high engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical space disaster/immersion scenarios involving exotic materials and extreme physics.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring extreme scale or rare cosmic phenomena like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (981 views, 21 likes) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (1,031 views, 36 likes) generate high view velocity.
winning_patterns.action: Continue utilizing high-contrast cosmic anomalies that challenge everyday intuition in the first 3 seconds.

weak_patterns.evidence: Content focusing on brain hacks and memory tricks (e.g., 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' with 5 views, 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' with 38 views) shows very low view velocity and poor engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard psychology trivia unless framed through a groundbreaking, high-stakes neurological mystery or sensory paradox.

weak_patterns.evidence: Basic animal facts such as 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (when repeated or lacking a high-stakes survival angle) underperform relative to space anomalies.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal content toward cinematic animal survival or extreme biological anomalies rather than basic trivia.
